title: allow read-only git grep against HEAD for reviewer roles so a non-Go prompt file can be checked against its base version

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-203303-45c3, project ork, item S571:

allow read-only git grep against HEAD for reviewer roles so a non-Go prompt file can be checked against its base version

Evidence: git -C WORKTREE grep -n ... HEAD -- internal/roles/prompts was denied as needing approval; the base overlays cover only Go files
